notes:
Inbound from product hunt / self-serve signup (trial credits used). Small engineering team (frontend + 1 ML eng). Use case: multi-source doc search + RAG for support KB and internal wikis. Interested in hosted API for speed-to-market; primarily public cloud. Key ask: embeddings + reranking flow and integration with vector DB (they currently evaluating Pinecone vs Weaviate vs using Redwood-hosted vectors).

Call highlights (2026-02-03 with Priya):
- "Got a 3-week timeline to demo a basic RAG search for support agents"
- Wants latency target: end-to-end search + rerank <200ms for most queries; happy to accept higher tail for complex queries.
- Data size: ~200k docs initially, expect to grow to ~1M in 12 months. Concerned about cost as scale grows.
- "We use Elasticsearch now but semantic relevance is poor; hoping embeddings + rerank fixes it."
- Questions about batching, tokenization, embedding dimensionality, and recommended index refresh cadence.
- Wants concrete guidance: which hosted model for embeddings, recommended vector DB config (index type, metric), and sample cost estimate for 200k docs + 5k queries/day.

Security / compliance notes:
- Needs SOC2 compliance and audit logging. SSO/SAML integration required for internal admin. Data residency: prefer US. No air-gapped/on-prem requirement today.

POC plan agreed:
- Redwood to provide hosted API trial keys + ~5 sample embedding calls for benchmark (Priya to send).
- SearchSpark to run ingest of a 50k doc subset, return sample top-K + reranked results, measure P95 latency and accuracy vs current ES baseline.
- Timeline: ingest + run tests by 2026-02-14, sync call 2026-02-17 to review results.

Sales notes / tone: low-touch SMB motion; cost sensitive but motivated to move quickly if POC shows clear relevance uplift. Might expand to Dedicated in 12-18 months if throughput/cost becomes a priority.
